72fb80f5c32329ca.description: Position Summary To operate a wide range of test rigs and assemble in multiple areas to maximum capacity and to produce goods of the highest quality. Responsibilities Setting and operating machine following the established procedures and standard work Instructions. Able to assemble/test all products within all assembly cells. To continually review and ensure all products manufactured meet the established quality standard. Read and follow instructions on drawings, routings, and ISO procedures so that the work produced meets requirements in terms of time and quality. Maintain a clean and tidy working environment to the company’s 5s standard so that the work area hazards are minimized, tooling and gauges etc. are protected and presentation meets the Company standard. Utilize all company provided personal protective equipment as well as other safety devices to ensure the job holders personal safety is maintained and that others are not jeopardized by their actions. Cooperate fully with the company’s Health, Safety and Environmental programs to ensure compliance at all times and that safe working practices are followed. Ensures effective handover to next shift especially where this involves the night shift or weekend shift in order that they can continue effective manufacturing. With increased experience, will train other Operators in the use of the machines, safety equipment and product. Expectation to host witness inspections as required. Fully contributing to problem solving activities An active and contributing HPT member. Production targets are met in terms of both numbers and timescales The jobholder follows standard work and ISO written procedures to manufacture product and identifies to supervision where procedures do not reflect optimum manufacture. The jobholder demonstrates flexibility in moving between tasks and machines. Contributes to the success of the team through active problem solving. Takes responsibility for personal actions and those of others who may be assigned to the job holder. Is seen as an effective communicator and team member in getting on with others, identifying issues to supervision etc. Co-operates with line management to achieve business objectives Maintains premier housekeeping standards and participates actively in 5S programme Maintains regular attendance and timekeeping Publicly demonstrates consistent support to the Division and line management. 722ffd65362fc55c.job_title: Restaurant General Manager - Premium French Restaurant
722ffd65362fc55c.description: Our client, a Riyadh-based hospitality investment group, is seeking an accomplished General Manager to lead a premium, chef-led French restaurant in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is the senior leadership role on site, with full ownership of the guest experience, operations, team and financial performance. The restaurant is the Riyadh home of an internationally recognised all-day French dining brand, with established restaurants in Dubai and London. The role offers the chance to set the standard for the brand in one of the most dynamic dining markets in the region, with a strong tax-free package and family sponsorship. Reporting to the Operations Director and ownership, the General Manager leads the Assistant General Manager, Restaurant Managers, beverage and guest relations teams, and partners closely with the Head Chef. We are looking for a hands-on, guest-facing leader who leads from the floor, is commercially sharp, and can deliver revenue, margin and EBITDA targets without compromising a premium experience. Responsibilities Set and uphold service standards across every touchpoint, from reservation to departure. Lead from the floor during service, personally engaging with guests, VIPs and regulars. Own guest feedback and complaint resolution, track reviews and drive continuous improvement. Build relationships with key clientele, corporate accounts and the local hospitality community. Run day-to-day front-of-house and back-of-house operations in partnership with the Head Chef. Oversee reservations, seating strategy, private dining and events. Ensure full compliance with KSA regulations, including SFDA requirements, municipal licensing, health and safety, and labour law. Maintain the venue, equipment and systems, and manage maintenance and supplier contracts. Lead opening and closing procedures, cash handling and security controls. Deliver revenue, gross margin and EBITDA targets agreed with ownership. Manage labour cost, cost of goods and operating expenses against budget, and prepare weekly and monthly reports. Drive covers, average spend and repeat business through service, menu engineering with the Head Chef, and local marketing. Control purchasing, stock and wastage, and manage supplier relationships. Recruit, onboard, train and retain a high-performing team, and build succession for key roles. Set rotas and manage headcount to forecast covers. Conduct performance reviews, coaching and disciplinary processes in line with company policy and Saudi labour law. Support Saudisation (Nitaqat) targets and develop local talent. Foster a respectful, inclusive culture across a multinational team. Protect and represent the brand in Riyadh, and work with the marketing team on launches, activations, social media and PR. Identify partnership, event and private-dining opportunities to grow revenue. Minimum 8 years in restaurant operations, with at least 3 years as General Manager of a premium or fine-dining restaurant. Proven P&L ownership of a venue with annual revenue of SAR 20 million or more, or equivalent. GCC experience strongly preferred; Saudi Arabia experience an advantage. A track record in a high-volume, high-expectation environment with VIP and corporate clientele. Pre-opening or relaunch experience an advantage. Strong financial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, cost control and reporting. Working knowledge of KSA hospitality regulation, licensing and labour law, including Saudisation requirements. Fluent English and French, written and spoken; Arabic an advantage. A hands-on, calm and culturally aware leader who builds loyal teams and develops people. Must hold the right to work in Saudi Arabia, or be eligible to obtain it with the client's support. Salary: SAR 35,000 to 45,000 per month total package, tax-free, depending on experience. Performance bonus. Duty meal on shift. Uniform provided. Housing and transport allowances included, medical insurance, service charge eligibility, visa sponsorship, family visas and annual flights for the family. Further benefits to be confirmed during the recruitment process. This is a full-time, permanent position working six days per week, including evenings, weekends and public holidays as required. The General Manager reports to the Operations Director and ownership, with a target start date of 1 January 2027. The role is based in Riyadh. Candidates must hold the right to work in Saudi Arabia, or be eligible to obtain it; the client will sponsor the work visa for the successful applicant. We appreciate your interest in this vacancy. Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates selected to move to the next stage of the recruitment process can be contacted. Radiant does not charge any fee to candidates; all costs are always covered by the client.

723f87cb92f414af.job_title: SAP Procurement Solutions Analyst - S/4HANA & Ariba (Saudi Arabia)
723f87cb92f414af.description: Job description We are seeking an experienced SAP Procurement Solutions Analyst – S/4HANA & Ariba to support and enhance procurement technology solutions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . The role will focus on enabling efficient and integrated Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, supporting procurement operations, supplier lifecycle management, sourcing, purchasing, and related digital procurement capabilities. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, procurement teams, IT teams, suppliers, and technology partners to analyze business requirements, support solution design, troubleshoot system issues, and drive continuous improvements across SAP procurement platforms. The work location would be at Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. Responsibilities Support and maintain procurement solutions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, and SAP BTP . Analyze business requirements and translate procurement processes into effective SAP solutions. Support SAP MM / Materials Management processes, including purchasing, purchase orders, goods/services procurement, and related master data. Support end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes and ensure effective integration between procurement systems. Provide functional support for SAP Ariba modules and capabilities, including: Ariba Sourcing Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP) Guided Buying Supplier onboarding Supplier relationship management Procurement and sourcing processes Support supplier lifecycle management , including supplier onboarding, qualification, maintenance, and integration with enterprise systems. Support service procurement processes, including Service Entry Sheets and related purchasing activities. Support procurement processes within SAP S/4HANA and ECC , ensuring alignment with business and operational requirements. Analyze and resolve system issues, incidents, and process-related challenges across SAP procurement platforms. Support integrations between SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP , and other enterprise applications. Work with technical teams to investigate integration issues, data flows, interfaces, and system defects. Participate in solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. Prepare and maintain functional specifications, process documentation, test scenarios, and user documentation. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and coordinate with business users to validate solutions. Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes through automation, system enhancements, and digital procurement capabilities. Collaborate with procurement, finance, supply chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet operational requirements. Support system upgrades, enhancements, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor procurement system performance and ensure timely resolution of business-critical issues. Preferred candidate Years of experience 1+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

72f2c4e5efe9631a.description: Overview The Master Data Quality Analyst is responsible for maintaining data accuracy, consistency, integrity, and compliance with established data quality standards. The role involves analyzing large datasets, identifying data discrepancies, supporting master data management and governance initiatives, and assisting in the maintenance of metadata repositories and business intelligence systems. The position also supports data quality reporting, dashboard maintenance, and the administration of BI tools to enable reliable, secure, and effective data-driven decision-making. Key Responsibilities Monitor and analyze enterprise datasets to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, discrepancies, and potential root causes. Support the development and implementation of master data management processes, data governance policies, standards, and procedures. Assist in establishing and maintaining data quality guidelines, metadata repositories, and data cataloguing practices. Contribute to the development and enforcement of data policies, standards, and best practices to ensure data consistency and integrity. Identify data quality gaps and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders to improve the reliability of business intelligence reports. Support the development, operation, and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and business intelligence solutions. Assist in configuring and administering BI tools, software, and related technology components to ensure operational efficiency. Manage BI user accounts, access permissions, and configurations in accordance with organizational roles and information security requirements. Provide technical support for BI tools, troubleshoot system issues, and assist in performance optimization activities. Ensure compliance with applicable information security, data privacy, and data management controls. Collaborate with the Master Data Quality Manager and other stakeholders to enhance data management practices and support informed business decision-making. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related discipline from a recognized and accredited university. 5–7 years of experience in data quality, master data management, data governance, business intelligence, or a related field. Experience in IT, data solutions, networking, cybersecurity, or information management is preferred. Knowledge of data quality management principles, master data management processes, metadata management, and data governance practices. Familiarity with business intelligence tools, dashboards, reporting systems, and data analysis techniques. Understanding of information security, data privacy, and access control principles. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. Proficiency in written and spoken English. Preferred Certification Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE).

720381dfe803851b.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is an AEP/PMCM firm recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. The company has over 60 years of experience in planning, design, and project delivery across built and natural environments. KEO is also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. Role Summary KEO International Consultants is seeking a Senior Contracts Manager to join the site supervision team in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience. The Senior Contracts Manager will lead and manage all commercial, contractual, and financial aspects of enabling and early works packages, acting on behalf of the Client as part of the Site Supervision Consultant team. The role focuses on contract administration, commercial governance, cost control, change management, and claims management, ensuring the Client’s commercial position is protected while supporting timely and compliant delivery of the Works. Key Responsibilities Lead contract administration for enabling and early works packages, including mass earthworks, stockpile removal, construction haul roads, utilities, and temporary works. Administer the Contract in accordance with the Conditions of Contract (including FIDIC-based forms), ensuring compliance with notice provisions, procedures, and time bars. Manage all contractual correspondence, notices, early warnings, claims, and determinations in coordination with the Engineer. Provide contractual and commercial advice to the Client and supervision team on entitlements, risks, mitigation strategies, and commercial exposure. Support procurement strategies, tender evaluations, commercial comparisons, and recommendations for contract award or amendment. Monitor, control, and report project budgets, cost forecasts, commitments, and cash flow for early works packages. Review, assess, and recommend certification of interim payment applications, dayworks, and final accounts. Manage change control processes including valuation of variations, compensation events, and instructed changes. Lead the assessment and management of contractor claims including extensions of time, prolongation, disruption, and acceleration claims. Maintain and update contract risk registers, proactively identifying and managing commercial and contractual risks. Ability to manage complex interfaces and commercial risk across multiple work fronts. Clear, structured communicator with strong written contractual drafting skills. KEO fosters a supportive environment that promotes professional development through internal global mobility and career development, alongside a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being.

72313995fc727bd4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن كاتب حسابات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة متنوعة من الواجبات الكتابية لدعم العمليات المحاسبية، وتحديث السجلات المالية اليومية، وضمان دقة المعاملات وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تجميع وتجهيز الفواتير المتعلقة بالمشتريات والمصروفات، وإعداد كشوفات العهد وسندات الصرف أو القبض وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. فتح حسابات دفترية وملفات خاصة لجميع الحسابات، وإغلاق حسابات المبيعات اليومية في نهاية كل يوم عمل، ومطابقة سندات القبض لصافي المبيعات اليومية بناءً على توجيهات الرئيس المباشر. تنفيذ العمليات الحسابية البسيطة وتسجيلها، وتحليل البيانات المالية مثل المتوسطات والنسب المئوية والمعدلات. حفظ السجلات المحاسبية والمستندات في الملفات المخصصة، والتحقق من دقة الفواتير والمستندات المحاسبية الأخرى. إعداد التقارير المالية، ومراجعة صيغها، وطباعة التقارير المالية وتوزيعها وفقًا لتعليمات الرئيس المباشر والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تحديث دفاتر المحاسبة اليومية ودفاتر الأستاذ والسجلات الأخرى. معرفة جيدة بالمعاملات التجارية المالية وكيفية إيرادها بالتفصيل. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إدخال البيانات والتحقق منها. القدرة على تنظيم وحفظ السجلات والمستندات المحاسبية. مهارات جيدة في إجراء العمليات الحسابية الأساسية وتحليل البيانات المالية. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. بيئة العمل يعمل كاتب الحسابات ضمن فريق شركة معين للموارد البشرية في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل منظمة تدعم العمليات المحاسبية اليومية وتلتزم بالسياسات والإجراءات المحددة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المقابلة والخبرة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

72f90e0ebf5f657f.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking a Shift Charge Engineer to oversee all plant operation activities during their assigned shift. This full-time position in Saudi Arabia requires ensuring that all plant operations are conducted safely and efficiently, adhering to approved Standard Operating Procedures, quality standards, and operational requirements. The role is critical for the safe startup and shutdown of the plant. Key Responsibilities Comply with all safety rules and regulations, maintaining full awareness of plant safety hazards. Operate the plant according to established standards, minimizing risks to personnel, machinery, and materials, while adhering to safety and environmental standards. Coordinate all plant operation activities with other departments during the shift, ensuring compliance with safety rules and regulations. Manage the permit-to-work system, including issuing and canceling permits as authorized, and coordinating activities with the Chemist. Follow operational schedules to achieve targeted production availability safely and efficiently, coordinating all plant status changes with the operations manager. Make prompt decisions to correct abnormalities or disturbances and take corrective actions during emergencies. Supervise startup checklists, interlock checks, protection tests, and non-routine activities such as preservation and acid cleaning. Issue work permits for maintenance sections upon authorization, normalize equipment after release, and perform necessary testing post-maintenance. Monitor overall plant status, summarize activities in the log book, and complete daily plant status reports. Maintain staff evaluation records, vacation schedules, and prepare evaluation forms for personnel requirements. Prepare incident/accident reports and other required departmental reports, submitting them within stipulated timeframes. Keep accurate records of all plant activities on a regular basis. Assist in the training and familiarization of new personnel within the shift. Suggest modifications to improve plant efficiency. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are carried out, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report on IMS objectives, targets, and programs. Report deviations in the Integrated Management System, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Ensure regulatory compliance within the scope of activities. Identify root causes for non-conformances/deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary actions. Carry out periodic performance evaluations of reporting employees and provide on-the-job training. Identify, document, and control hazards in the assigned work area. Ensure identified aspects are monitored and operational controls are followed. Control emergencies, incidents, and near misses. Communicate with the load dispatch center. Perform other assigned duties. Qualifications and Experience Education: A Bachelor of Engineering is required. A postgraduate degree in engineering with power plant engineering is preferred. Experience: A minimum of 8 years of experience in Power, Desalination, or RO plants is required. Experience in similar plants within the Middle East is preferred. The role requires 8-10 years of overall experience. Required Skills and Knowledge Familiarity with plant O&M agreements, P&IDs, SOPs, work instructions, operation and control logics, emergency operation procedures, and regulatory requirements. Strong understanding of permit-to-work systems. Ability to make quick, effective decisions under pressure. Proficiency in monitoring plant status and preparing detailed reports. Capability to identify and address competency gaps in subordinates. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, requiring active participation in plant operations during shifts. The role involves working within a team and coordinating with various departments to ensure operational excellence and safety. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software. Experience coordinating cross-border financial matters between China and Saudi Arabia is an advantage.

72095db1c2bd08d0.job_title: Condition Monitoring Engineer - MCSA, Vibration & Motion Amplification
72095db1c2bd08d0.description: IRISS, Inc. | Saudi Arabia | Remote (Field-Based / Client Site Visits) | Full-Time About IRISS IRISS is a global leader in industrial safety and condition-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide. Headquartered in Bradenton, Florida, USA, we design and manufacture innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected. Our technologies help organizations prevent equipment failures, reduce operational risks, and protect their people. With operations across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India, IRISS continues to expand its global presence while maintaining a commitment to innovation, reliability, and workplace safety. Our mission is simple: Humanizing Safety. Website: https://iriss.com/| YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Irissemsd Position Summary IRISS is seeking an experienced and technically skilled Condition Monitoring Engineer to support our operations in Saudi Arabia. This remote, field-based position focuses on delivering advanced predictive maintenance and asset reliability services using Motor Current Signature Analysis (MCSA), Vibration Analysis, and Motion Amplification technologies. The successful candidate will perform equipment diagnostics, identify developing faults, conduct root cause analysis, and provide actionable recommendations to improve the reliability and performance of rotating and electromechanical equipment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering professional with strong analytical abilities, industrial field experience, and the ability to work independently while supporting customers throughout Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. Key Responsibilities Motor Current Signature Analysis (MCSA) • Perform online and offline MCSA inspections on AC/DC motors, generators, and associated driven equipment. • Diagnose electrical and mechanical faults, including broken rotor bars, air-gap eccentricity, stator winding defects, load abnormalities, and coupling or belt issues. • Analyze current, voltage, torque, and power spectra to identify developing equipment problems. • Correlate MCSA findings with vibration measurements, operational conditions, and process data. • Prepare detailed diagnostic reports outlining equipment condition, fault severity, and corrective recommendations. Vibration Analysis • Collect and analyze vibration data using portable and online condition monitoring systems. • Perform FFT analysis, time waveform analysis, enveloping, phase analysis, and orbit analysis. • Identify machinery faults such as unbalance, misalignment, mechanical looseness, bearing defects, gearbox faults, and resonance. • Conduct route-based and continuous condition monitoring inspections. • Monitor vibration trends to evaluate equipment condition and support remaining useful life assessments. Motion Amplification • Perform Motion Amplification inspections using advanced video-based vibration analysis technologies. • Identify structural resonance, soft foot, mechanical looseness, foundation defects, and piping vibration. • Evaluate equipment movement and structural behavior to support troubleshooting and reliability improvement. • Integrate Motion Amplification findings with vibration and MCSA diagnostic results. • Develop visual reports and amplified motion videos to communicate findings to engineering, maintenance, and management teams. Reliability Engineering & Technical Reporting • Prepare accurate, comprehensive, and actionable condition monitoring reports. • Recommend corrective maintenance actions based on diagnostic findings. • Support Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) investigations. • Collaborate with customer maintenance, reliability, and operations teams. • Assist in developing and improving predictive maintenance programs, reliability strategies, and performance indicators. • Communicate technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Qualifications • Bachelor's degree or technical diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent technical experience. • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, or reliability engineering. • Hands-on experience diagnosing rotating machinery, including motors, pumps, fans, compressors, and gearboxes. • Practical knowledge of vibration analysis and electrical motor diagnostics. • Experience using vibration analysis software, data collectors, and diagnostic equipment. • Understanding of signal processing, equipment reliability, and industrial maintenance practices. • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. • Excellent technical reporting, communication, and presentation skills. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and technical reporting applications. • Ability to work independently and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. Preferred Qualifications & Certifications • Vibration Analysis Certification – ISO Category I, II, or III. • Motor Current Signature Analysis certification or specialized training from SKF, Emerson, or an equivalent provider. • Motion Amplification training or certification from RDI Technologies or an equivalent provider. • Additional reliability engineering or condition monitoring certifications. • Experience with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) and asset management platforms. • Experience working with Motion Amplification equipment and high-speed camera systems. • Industrial experience in oil and gas, power generation, utilities, manufacturing, mining, cement, or petrochemical facilities. • Previous experience supporting industrial customers in Saudi Arabia or other GCC countries. Technical Competencies • Motor Current Signature Analysis (MCSA). • Vibration monitoring and diagnostics. • Motion Amplification technology. • Rotating equipment troubleshooting. • Predictive and condition-based maintenance. • Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA). • Signal processing and spectral analysis. • Industrial asset reliability and maintenance optimization. • Technical reporting and customer communication. Work Environment & Travel • Remote position based in Saudi Arabia, with regular field assignments and customer site visits. • Conduct inspections and technical evaluations at industrial and operational facilities. • Work around rotating machinery, electrical equipment, and other industrial systems. • Travel throughout Saudi Arabia and potentially other GCC countries as business needs require. • Follow company health, safety, and environmental policies and applicable site safety regulations. • Maintain readiness to perform hands-on technical inspections in industrial environments. Employment Requirements • Ability to legally work in Saudi Arabia or meet applicable work authorization requirements. • Valid passport and ability to travel internationally when required. • Ability to meet applicable medical fitness and industrial site access requirements. • Employment subject to applicable Saudi Arabian labor regulations and company policies. Why Join IRISS? At IRISS, you're not just joining a company — you're joining a growing global organization committed to innovation, reliability, and workplace safety. 7223b5626e955528.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيوت السحاب عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي ومتابعة المحتوى بشكل مستمر. إعداد وتنفيذ خطة المحتوى وجدولة المنشورات والحملات التسويقية. كتابة وتطوير المحتوى بما يتناسب مع هوية العلامة التجارية والجمهور المستهدف. إعداد وتنفيذ الحملات الإعلانية الممولة ومتابعة أدائها وتحسين نتائجها. تحليل أداء الحسابات والحملات وتقديم التوصيات بناءً على النتائج. متابعة الترندات والمنافسين واقتراح أفكار ومحتوى وحملات جديدة. التنسيق مع المصممين وصناع المحتوى ومتابعة تنفيذ المواد التسويقية. استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي والتقنيات الحديثة لتطوير المحتوى وتحسين كفاءة العمل. تنظيم ومتابعة المهام والملفات والبيانات الخاصة بالتسويق. الخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق في المدينة المنورة، في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب متابعة مستمرة لأحدث التطورات في مجال التسويق الرقمي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7236cc7c86476fd9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يقوم شاغل الوظيفة بإجراء التحاليل والاختبارات المخبرية والكيميائية على العينات المختلفة، مع الالتزام بالمعايير المعتمدة ومتطلبات الجودة والسلامة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتحضير وتجهيز العينات لإجراء التحاليل المخبرية. إجراء التحاليل والاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها ودقتها. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد الكيميائية اللازمة للتحليل. مراجعة نتائج التحاليل والتأكد من دقتها ومطابقتها لمتطلبات الجودة. تسجيل وتوثيق نتائج الفحوصات في الأنظمة والسجلات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط الجودة ومراقبة جودة نتائج التحاليل. المحافظة على العينات والأجهزة والمواد المخبرية وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. الإبلاغ عن أي نتائج غير مطابقة أو أعطال فنية للمسؤول المختص. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب بيئة المختبر. إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالتحاليل والنتائج حسب متطلبات العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء التحاليل والاختبارات المخبرية والكيميائية بدقة. معرفة بالطرق والإجراءات والمعايير المعتمدة في التحاليل المخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. القدرة على تحضير المحاليل والكواشف الكيميائية. الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. مهارات جيدة في توثيق النتائج وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل الكيميائي في مختبرات شركة اجال للمختبرات بمدينة نجران، ضمن بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب بيئة العمل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

72720ea972970400.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Senior Manager - Landscape to join Botanica, its subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery. Botanica focuses on integrating new species with local flora across Red Sea Global’s destinations, operating over 1 million square meters with a planet-first approach to sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a goal of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala. The team is committed to ecological harmony and pioneering new global benchmarks in sustainable development. Role Overview The Senior Manager - Landscape will provide leadership and direction for landscape maintenance operations across assigned projects and destinations. This full-time role involves collaboration with various internal departments, including Facilities Management, Community Management, Projects, Asset Management, Procurement, Finance, Legal, HSE, HR, and IT, to ensure integrated delivery of landscape services. Key Responsibilities Provide overall leadership and direction for landscape maintenance operations. Develop and implement annual landscape maintenance plans, operational strategies, work programs, and resource requirements. Lead and manage Landscape Managers, Supervisors, technical teams, and field workforce. Oversee softscape, horticultural, irrigation, plant health, and landscape maintenance activities to ensure quality and presentation standards. Manage manpower planning, deployment, productivity, and resource utilization. Conduct regular operational and site performance reviews and ensure timely closure of quality observations and corrective actions. Oversee irrigation performance, water efficiency, fertilization programs, pest and disease control, pruning, planting, and seasonal landscape activities. Establish and monitor KPIs related to landscape quality, productivity, plant health, work completion, manpower utilization, costs, and service performance. Manage operational budgets, forecasts, cost control, and expenditure. Oversee requirements related to purchase requisitions, POs, invoices, materials, equipment, machinery, and operational services. Manage contractors, suppliers, and service providers to meet contractual, quality, safety, and operational requirements. Ensure availability and effective utilization of plants, landscape materials, fertilizers, chemicals, machinery, vehicles, tools, and equipment. Maintain strong coordination with clients, project teams, Nursery, Irrigation, HSE, Procurement, Finance, Logistics, Facilities, and other stakeholders. Lead the resolution of operational issues, client observations, service deficiencies, and complaints. Ensure full compliance with HSE, environmental, quality, company policies, and approved operational procedures. Lead the mobilization and operational readiness of new landscape maintenance projects. Identify and implement opportunities to improve service quality, productivity, sustainability, water efficiency, operational efficiency, and cost optimization. Review operational reports and performance dashboards and provide management with regular updates, risks, recommendations, and improvement plans. Develop Managers and Supervisors through coaching, performance management, technical guidance, and succession planning. Ensure landscape maintenance operations consistently meet business objectives, client expectations, contractual requirements, and service standards. Review proposals, scopes of work, BOQs, and commercial submissions, and support procurement and contract negotiations. Monitor expenditure, identify cost optimization opportunities, and ensure efficient resource utilization. Act as the senior landscape focal point for internal departments, clients, operators, consultants, contractors, and relevant authorities. Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and adoption of best practices, technology, and sustainable landscape solutions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in landscape management. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

7286903897e0e34e.description: About the Role Virtucruit is partnering with a frozen food manufacturer in Saudi Arabia to appoint an Operations Director (Factory Head) in Dammam. This is a senior leadership position with full strategic and operational accountability for the manufacturing facility. The role involves shaping and executing the plant's operational strategy, building a high-performing organization, and delivering against ambitious targets for output, quality, cost, and safety. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the operational strategy for the facility, aligning with company growth ambitions and commercial plans. Lead the transformation and modernization of the plant, including capacity expansion, automation, and capital investment planning. Translate business objectives into clear operational targets and a roadmap for the operations team. Drive operational excellence through lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement programs. Improve key metrics such as OEE, yield, throughput, labor productivity, and waste reduction. Establish robust planning and scheduling disciplines to ensure on-time, in-full delivery against demand. Oversee the full production operation, from raw material intake through processing, freezing, packing, and dispatch. Ensure reliability and performance of all plant assets, including cold-chain, freezing, and refrigeration infrastructure, through proactive maintenance. Ensure full compliance with all food safety, quality, and regulatory standards, including SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, and GMP. Lead, develop, and inspire a multi-disciplinary workforce across production, quality, engineering, and supply chain. Manage the facility's operating budget and capital plan, with full P&L accountability for the cost of operations. Drive cost optimization across labor, materials, energy, and overhead while maintaining quality and safety standards. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven track record at Operations Director, Plant Director, or Head of Factory level, leading a full facility at scale. Demonstrated success in delivering operational excellence, plant transformation, and measurable improvements in cost, efficiency, and quality. Deep expertise in food safety and quality systems, with hands-on command of SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, and GMP. Strong engineering, maintenance, and capital project experience, including cold-chain and freezing infrastructure. Exceptional leadership presence, commercial judgment, and the ability to build and lead high-performing teams. A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, requiring a leader who can embed a culture of excellence to position the plant as a benchmark in the frozen food sector. Application Process Candidates interested in this Operations Director role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

72a7bf74c5a588cd.description: About the Role Al Lujain Group is seeking a Head of Design and Technical Office to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position reports directly to the Executive Director and is responsible for overseeing a comprehensive range of design and technical services, from initial concept to project closeout, ensuring buildability and adherence to established standards. Departmental Scope The Design and Technical Office delivers various services essential to project execution. These services ensure that all design aspects are meticulously planned and documented for successful implementation. Concept and schematic interior design, including space planning and zoning. Design development, encompassing layouts, ceilings, elevations, finishes, joinery, and furniture. Mechanical, electrical, and low-current design and coordination for fit-out scopes. Preparation of construction, shop, joinery, and production drawings for the company's factory. Material and finish specification and scheduling. Three-dimensional visualization and client presentation materials. Technical support to site teams during construction phases. As-built records at project closeout. Key Accountabilities The Head of Design and Technical Office holds primary responsibility for the efficient and compliant operation of the department, ensuring all deliverables meet company standards and project requirements. Department Management: Oversee resourcing, workload distribution, adherence to standards, and team competence. Appoint a named design lead for each project in writing before design commencement. Design Program: Agree on the design program with project managers for every project and ensure adherence. Document in writing any instances where the brief, budget, and schedule cannot all be met before work proceeds. Review and Issue: Review and sign all drawings, schedules, and specifications before they are issued from the department. Ensure every design is independently checked by a person other than the original producer. Buildability: Verify that designs are feasible for construction by Al Lujain. Any detail exceeding the factory's or site's capabilities must be agreed upon with the factory and project manager prior to issue. Standards: Maintain a single set of departmental standards for drawing coding, title blocks, layering, finish codes, and drawing levels across all projects. External Designers: Appoint, brief, and review external designers to ensure their work aligns with internal standards. The appointment of external services does not transfer responsibility for issued work. Cost Management: Design within budget constraints and lead value engineering efforts when pricing exceeds targets, while safeguarding the design intent. Change Control: Implement changes only upon written instruction. All changes must be recorded, priced if they incur cost or time implications, and re-issued under a new revision. Site Support: Respond to technical queries and RFIs within agreed timeframes and manage as-built records at project closeout. People Management: Assess departmental members against the capability register, documenting specific actions and dates for addressing any identified gaps. Authority and Decision-Making The appointee is empowered to make critical decisions regarding design quality and compliance, ensuring that all outputs meet the required standards, even under tight deadlines. Hold an issue, reject a drawing, or require a re-check if it does not meet the design policy, irrespective of project deadlines. Prevent a design from being issued to the Client or site if it does not meet established standards. Appoint the design lead for each project and allocate departmental resources accordingly. Recommend the appointment of external design consultants and reject their output if it fails to meet expectations. Should holding an issue impact a commitment made to a Client, the appointee is required to escalate the matter to the Executive Director on the same day. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess extensive experience in design and technical office management within a relevant industry. A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in design and technical office functions. Demonstrated leadership and management capabilities in overseeing design teams and processes. Strong understanding of design principles, construction methods, and industry standards. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Understand a simple or basic Quality product. Not Color blind

72cfe5e389e6156d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صحة زينة المتطورة للأدوية عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة البيانات وتدقيقها وإدخالها وتخزينها بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. الهدف من الوظيفة الهدف الأساسي لمدخل البيانات هو ضمان دقة واكتمال المعلومات المدخلة والمخزنة، مع الالتزام بالتعليمات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما شابه ذلك. المهام والمسؤوليات مراجعة الاستمارات المتعلقة بالبيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمالها. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات في الحاسب الآلي بحسب البرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة، وتصويب الأخطاء فيها لضمان الدقة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وفعالة. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة بشكل دوري. التقيد الصارم بالتعليمات والإرشادات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدخال البيانات أو دور مشابه. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسب الآلي وأنظمة إدخال البيانات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل مدخل البيانات ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة صحة زينة المتطورة للأدوية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

72db6da4bb1bd08c.description: About the Internship AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is offering a Data Center Technician Internship in Riyadh. This 3-month, full-time internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment, with strong-performing interns considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position based on available roles and business needs. Interns will work as part of the Operations team, focusing on the maintenance and upkeep of data center infrastructure. Role Responsibilities As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will provide infrastructure-related support to internal teams, resolving tickets related to hardware and networking. This role involves both independent work and team collaboration. Key responsibilities include: Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians. Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for assigned trouble tickets. Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to develop diagnostic skills. Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) according to AWS Data Tech guidance. Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians. Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors on site. Learning and Development Beyond hardware and network repair, you will learn equipment installation, documentation creation, solution innovation, and complex problem-solving within the data center environment. The internship provides exposure to diagnosing and repairing servers and networks that support AWS operations for millions of customers. Mentors and teammates will support your growth and skill development. Internship Structure and Schedule This is a full-time internship (40 hours per week) for three consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. The position requires daily on-site reporting. Intern schedules are typically day shifts, Sunday through Thursday. Candidates should be aware that a full-time Data Center Technician position may involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations, and willingness to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time role is required. About the Team The AWS Infrastructure Services team is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. This includes supporting AWS data centers and all associated servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment. You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers, collaborating to maintain high standards for safety and security while providing infrastructure capacity for customers. Qualifications and Experience This internship is suitable for individuals with 0-1 years of experience. Critical skills for success include prioritization, organizational abilities, effective communication, and the capacity to react quickly to situations.

72eeb39537d500ca.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an Architectural BIM Coordinator to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 4-7 years of experience and focuses on developing and coordinating architectural BIM models within multidisciplinary project environments. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain detailed architectural BIM models using Autodesk Revit, ACC, and Navisworks. Coordinate architectural models with structural and MEP disciplines, resolving design and coordination issues. Identify, manage, and resolve clashes to ensure coordinated and construction-ready BIM models. Support the preparation of construction/shop drawings and BIM deliverables. Ensure BIM models and deliverables comply with project BIM standards, LOD requirements, and the BIM Execution Plan. Coordinate with project teams and stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of BIM outputs. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience in steel structure projects is required. Strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), and Navisworks. Good understanding of BIM coordination, clash detection, LOD requirements, and BIM workflows. Experience working in multidisciplinary project environments. Work Environment This role operates within a collaborative project environment, requiring coordination with various disciplines and stakeholders to achieve project objectives. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

7220d96cfd12d71c.description: KnowledgeCity is seeking to recruit a qualified Restaurant Accountant to join its finance team in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The candidate must have practical accounting experience within the restaurant sector and proficiency in using the Foodics system to manage sales and daily operations. Requirements Duties and Responsibilities • Review daily sales and reconcile them with Foodics system reports, cash collections, and electronic payments. • Prepare daily cash register closing reports, review financial discrepancies, and handle their resolution. • Monitor food and beverage costs, analyze cost of goods sold (COGS), and track food cost percentages. • Monitor inventory, item movements, purchases, and waste, conduct periodic stock counts, and analyze inventory variances. • Review supplier invoices, reconcile them with purchase orders, and follow up on payables. • Reconcile sales settlements and commissions for food delivery platforms, such as Jahez, Hungerstation, and Keeta. • Prepare periodic financial reports and analyze revenues, expenses, and branch financial performance. • Perform bank reconciliations, review expenses, and assist in monthly accounting closes. • Monitor VAT compliance and ensure adherence to accounting and tax regulations applicable in Saudi Arabia. Qualifications and Requirements • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. • At least three years of practical accounting experience, preferably in restaurants or the food and beverage (F&B) sector. • Proven hands-on experience using the Foodics system for POS management, reporting, and sales reconciliation. • Strong knowledge of restaurant accounting, F&B costing, and inventory management. • Experience in bank reconciliations, auditing cash/electronic collections, and delivery platform settlements. • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, financial reporting, and financial analysis. • Knowledge of VAT requirements and accounting practices in Saudi Arabia. • High accuracy, ability to analyze financial variances, and commitment to meeting reporting deadlines.

7226d1492bb9dc0f.description: Job Description Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. 7254e59e466e60c7.description: Job Description The Turbine & Precision Equipment Rigger is responsible for executing highly critical, heavy, and precision lifting operations during power plant turbine outages and industrial maintenance shutdowns. This role demands exceptional technical expertise to safely handle multi-million dollar rotating equipment, gas/steam turbine components, and delicate machinery within tightly restricted spaces. The successful candidate must strictly adhere to engineered lifting plans, maintain zero-compromise safety standards, and display flawless precision under fast-paced outage timelines. Key Responsibilities Rigging Execution: Safely attach, lift, guide, and position heavy turbine components and associated mechanical equipment in strict compliance with approved, engineered lifting plans . Compliance & Safety Verification: Audit all lifting tackle before use to verify valid identification tags, current inspection status, and Working Load Limits (WLL) . Precision Maneuvering: Expertly guide immense structural loads through highly restricted areas and congested plant environments utilizing controlled mechanical methods and precise signaling. Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years of proven experience as an industrial rigger, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed major turbine outages, power plant shutdowns, or heavy mechanical maintenance . Technical Skills: Comprehensive knowledge of rigging mathematics, center-of-gravity calculations, crane signals, and rigging hardware capacities. Certifications: Valid third-party rigging certifications (such as TUV, Bureau Veritas, Aramco, or equivalents ) are highly preferred. Physical Capability: Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and handle the physical demands of 12-hour shifts typical during emergency or scheduled outages. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork orientation, high attention to detail, and a strict commitment to safety protocols.

722de378afd72e8a.description: Cluster Director of HR Job Description The Cluster Director of Human Resources is a key member of the cluster leadership team, responsible for leading the people strategy across multiple hotels within the portfolio. The Cluster Director of Human Resources will oversee all aspects of human capital management across hotels with different positioning, operating models, and staffing requirements. The successful candidate will combine commercial awareness with strong people leadership capabilities to support business performance, organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and long-term talent sustainability across the portfolio. Key Responsibilities Strategic Human Resources Leadership • Develop and execute a cluster-wide Human Resources strategy aligned with business objectives, hotel operating models, ownership priorities, and brand requirements. • Serve as a strategic advisor to the Cluster General Manager and hotel leadership teams on all people-related matters. • Establish organizational structures, workforce plans, and staffing strategies appropriate for each property's positioning and operating model. • Drive a high-performance culture focused on accountability, development, engagement, and service excellence. • Support long-term talent planning and organizational effectiveness across the portfolio. Pre-Opening Human Resources Management • Lead all Human Resources pre-opening activities from project handover through opening and stabilization. • Develop and manage the Human Resources pre-opening critical path and readiness plan. • Support the preparation, review, and management of Human Resources Pre-Opening Budgets (POB). • Develop pre-opening staffing plans, mobilization strategies, and recruitment timelines. • Establish hotel organizational structures, position control frameworks, grading structures, and manpower plans. • Implement HR policies, procedures, systems, and employee lifecycle processes prior to opening. • Coordinate onboarding, orientation, and hotel opening induction programs. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning • Lead recruitment strategies for all hotels across the cluster. • Ensure leadership and critical positions are filled in accordance with opening timelines. • Develop recruitment partnerships with hospitality schools, training providers, and external agencies. • Implement workforce planning initiatives to optimize labor resources across the portfolio. • Support cluster-wide recruitment campaigns and talent pipeline development programs. • Establish succession planning strategies for key operational and leadership roles. Saudi National Development & Compliance • Develop and implement Saudization strategies aligned with regulatory requirements and business objectives. • Establish recruitment, training, and development programs for Saudi nationals. • Partner with government agencies, universities, hospitality academies, and training institutions to develop future talent pipelines. • Monitor compliance with labor legislation, Saudization targets, GOSI requirements, and employment regulations. • Ensure proper workforce reporting and government compliance across all properties. Learning & Development • Establish cluster training and development strategies. • Develop leadership development and succession planning programmes. • Implement pre-opening training, service culture, and onboarding initiatives. • Support operational departments in building technical and leadership capabilities. • Monitor training effectiveness and organizational capability development. • Foster a culture of continuous learning and career development. Employee Engagement & Culture • Lead employee engagement initiatives, culture-building activities, and recognition programmes. • Develop programs that promote collaboration across the hotel portfolio. • Drive employee well-being, inclusion, and retention initiatives. • Monitor engagement survey results and implement action plans. • Support the development of a strong employer brand and employee value proposition Performance Management & Organizational Development • Establish performance management frameworks across the portfolio. • Support leaders in performance coaching, talent reviews, and development planning. • Drive organizational effectiveness and change management initiatives. • Support leadership teams in managing performance, employee relations, and workforce challenges. • Promote accountability and continuous improvement throughout the organization. Compensation & Benefits • Oversee compensation and benefits programmes across the hotel cluster. • Ensure compensation structures remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with market conditions. • Support annual salary review, incentive planning, and workforce budgeting processes. • Monitor labor costs and staffing productivity metrics. • Partner with Finance and Operations teams to align manpower and compensation strategies with business objectives. Financial Management • Prepare and manage Human Resources operating budgets and pre-opening budgets. • Support manpower budgeting and labor cost forecasting across the portfolio. • Monitor recruitment costs, training investments, employee housing budgets, transportation costs, uniforms, and other HR-related expenditures. • Identify opportunities to improve productivity and optimize labor resources. • Ensure HR initiatives deliver measurable business value and return on investment. Stakeholder Management • Act as the primary Human Resources representative for ownership, hotel leadership, and external stakeholders. • Build strong relationships with government authorities, educational institutions, training providers, and recruitment partners. • Provide workforce analytics and people insights to support strategic decision-making. • Participate in project meetings, business reviews, and opening readiness assessments. The Ideal Candidate The successful candidate will be a commercially minded and people-focused HR leader with a strong track record of supporting hotel openings, workforce mobilization, organizational development, and talent strategies across multiple properties. You will bring: • Proven Human Resources leadership experience within hotels, hospitality portfolios, mixeduse developments, or complex service organizations. • Strong pre-opening experience including workforce planning, recruitment mobilization, HR systems implementation, and opening readiness activities. • Experience preparing manpower budgets, staffing structures, and Human Resources Pre- Opening Budgets (POB). • Strong understanding of labor laws, employment regulations, Saudization requirements, and workforce compliance in Saudi Arabia. • Demonstrated expertise in talent acquisition, employee relations, organizational development, succession planning, compensation, and performance management. • Experience establishing organizational structures and staffing models for hotels with varying positioning and operating requirements. • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with ownership, operating team, and government authorities. • A collaborative leadership style with a passion for developing talent and building highperforming teams. • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to align people strategies with business goals. • Excellent communication, coaching, and change management capabilities. 7239def15315272f.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع الاخدود الطبي في نجران عن أخصائي علاج طبيعي للانضمام إلى فريقه. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية، ووضع خطط العلاج الطبيعي، ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج للمرضى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل برنامج المعالجة الطبيعية المحدد من قبل الطبيب الأخصائي، وتحديد خطوات وإجراءات وتوقيت ومراحل تنفيذ البرنامج. مراقبة مدى التقدم الصحي للمريض ودرجة استجابته للعلاج بشكل مستمر. تحديد التمارين والحركات التقويمية اللازمة وتحديد معدلات تكرارها بالتنسيق مع الطبيب المعالج. تدليك المرضى لتحسين أداء عضلات الجسم المصاب وتدريبهم على التمارين اللازمة. تدريب المصابين على استخدام الأثقال وبكرات الشد والآلات الرياضية وأجهزة العوارض، وتنفيذ الحركات الأرضية لتقوية عضلات الأطراف والظهر والعنق. تدريب المصاب وذويه على التمارين الواجب متابعتها من المنزل لضمان استمرارية العلاج. ضبط وتنظيم الأجهزة المستخدمة في العلاج الطبيعي لضمان فعاليتها وسلامتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالعلاج الطبيعي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال العلاج الطبيعي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في وضع خطط العلاج ومتابعة تنفيذها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل فعالة مع المرضى وذويهم. القدرة على تدريب المرضى على التمارين والحركات العلاجية. معرفة جيدة بتشغيل وصيانة أجهزة العلاج الطبيعي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالعلاج. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العلاج الطبيعي ضمن فريق مجمع الاخدود الطبي في نجران، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.
